title: Recognition Basis for Pre-Buy Drawdowns in a Refined Fuels Plan Year
content:
Money applied against pre-buy bookings on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts is recognised in the plan year's cost only so far as the member's booking position warrants. The share recognised turns on the gallons booked on the account and the gallons drawn against those bookings.

| Gallons booked on the account | Gallons drawn against those bookings | Share of the money applied against pre-buy bookings that is recognised |
| --- | --- | --- |
| At or above the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons | 1000 gallons or more | The whole of it |
| At or above the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons | Fewer than 1000 gallons | Half of it, the share standing at 0.5 |
| Below the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons | Either way | None of it |

## Reading the two tests

The first test is on the gallons booked, measured against the minimum pre-buy gallons the catalogue writes for the programme the account sits on. Where that test fails, nothing of the drawdown money is recognised however many gallons have been drawn.

The second test is on the gallons drawn against those bookings, measured against 1000 gallons. It is reached at 1000 gallons exactly.

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical inputs)

*Fully recognised.* An account whose gallons booked stand at the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons and whose gallons drawn against bookings stand at 1000.0 recognises the whole of the money applied against pre-buy bookings. On 1400.00 USD applied over the year, 1400.00 USD enters the year's cost.

*Half recognised.* The same account with 999.0 gallons drawn against its bookings recognises half. On 1400.00 USD applied, 700.00 USD enters the year's cost.

*Not recognised.* An account whose gallons booked fall one gallon short of the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons recognises none of it, and nothing of the 1400.00 USD enters the year's cost.
